children: Long.xyz founder Nate said the platform is not designed around a single Meme, AI, or market trend, but is intended to reduce the risk of asset failure caused by one factor through continuous iteration. According to Odaily, he said one of the main problems in the crypto market is a lack of trust and long-term holding expectations, with many assets potentially going to zero in a short period, while many users want to hold assets for the long term.

Nate said Long.xyz emphasizes balance across different factors, including maintaining relatively deep liquidity while preserving room for high-multiple returns. He said assets need Meme characteristics but cannot be pure Meme assets, and development teams can promote projects but cannot be the only support, as the community must also participate.

He added that Long.xyz plans to combine assets with RWA, U.S. stock catalysts, and AI, while limiting the impact of sharp declines in major crypto assets on the ecosystem without fully separating from the crypto market cycle. Nate also said Long.xyz wants to reduce pure short-term PVP between assets while keeping competition between different assets and routes. He said the platform’s approach is to ensure assets can survive first, then move quickly and continue iterating, balancing daily tactical adjustments with long-term goals.

title: Long.xyz Founder Nate Says Platform Aims to Reduce Asset Failure Risk
